sources.title: MSDiT: Masked Spatial-Temporal Diffusion Transformer
sources.snippet: MSDiT is a unified video diffusion model that employs spatial-temporal masks and a pure Transformer backbone to tackle tasks like unconditional generation, prediction, interpolation, and completion. It tokenizes videos using a frozen VAE and processes them via alternating temporal and spatial self-attention layers with adaptive LayerNorm for effective diffusion time-conditioning. sources.title: Spatial Mask Merging - GitHub
sources.snippet: Spatial thresholds, edge weighting factors, and clustering penalties govern the behavior of the Spatial Mask Merging (SMM) algorithm. These parameters control the balance between over-merging and under-merging, spatial sensitivity, and candidate mask selection.
